shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the right-branch mark at (2,0) on the left with the left-hand mark on the horizontal trace on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed function has no value at x=2. Right image: The displayed function has no value at x=0.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=2. On the right, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=0.
